name: Legal Contract Review
description: Contract review meeting template for legal, procurement, commercial, and compliance discussions.

sections.title: Review Metadata
sections.instruction: Contract name, counterparty, version, reviewers, meeting date, and review stage

sections.title: Business Context
sections.instruction: Summarize the deal, relationship, commercial objective, timeline, and business owner

sections.title: Clauses Discussed
sections.instruction: List contract clauses or sections reviewed, issue raised, proposed language, and owner

sections.title: Risk Assessment
sections.instruction: Summarize legal, commercial, data, privacy, security, compliance, or operational risks discussed

sections.title: Negotiation Positions
sections.instruction: Capture fallback positions, non-negotiables, acceptable compromises, and escalation points

sections.title: Approvals Needed
sections.instruction: List internal approvals, stakeholders, conditions, and target dates required before signature

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List drafting, review, negotiation, and communication actions with owners and due dates
